risks.description: Client assets (payment provider account, final product photos) arrive late and delay checkout and catalog work.
risks.mitigation: Requested in this report with dates. Fallback: launch with placeholder photos and swap them after go-live.

risks.description: Ordering API work is concentrated on one backend developer and exceeds her capacity next week.
risks.mitigation: Move rate limiting to post-launch hardening, or shift 8h of integration work to the frontend developer.

risks.description: Old-site URLs lose search traffic after launch if redirects are incomplete.
risks.mitigation: 301 redirect map is part of Content & SEO; Search Console monitored for two weeks after launch.
